lines: For accomplishment of identity state at every juncture should practice; others but east north west south directions fourfold.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tanmayībhāvasiddhyarthaṃ pratisandhyaṃ samācaret anye tu prāgudakpaścāddaśadikṣu catuṣṭayīm
